item.title: CRITICAL BUG: File Creation/Editing Tools Report Success But Write No Content
item.body:
Type: Bug Summary: The create_file and replace_string_in_file tools consistently report "The following files were successfully edited" but actually create empty files (0 bytes), making file-based tasks impossible. Reproduction: Use any file creation/editing tool with substantial content Tool reports success File exists but is completely empty 100% reproducible across multiple attempts and content types Environment: VS Code with latest GitHub Copilot extension macOS, zsh shell Claude-based model Large monorepo workspace Impact: Critical - Core functionality completely broken False success confirmations mislead users Blocks all documentation and file-based development tasks Wastes significant time due to false confirmations Evidence: Just demonstrated live: Created bug report file, tool reported success, file is 0 bytes Consistent pattern across multiple sessions and file types File permissions are correct, paths are valid, content is properly formatted This is a high-priority bug that needs immediate attention as it makes the file editing tools completely unusable while providing misleading success feedback.
